summary: This bill requires the Environmental Protection Agency to set water quality criteria and effluent limitations for perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) for various industries, mandate monitoring of PFAS discharges, and provide grants to publicly owned treatment works to address PFAS contamination.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on establishing stricter regulations and monitoring for PFAS chemicals in water, which directly aims to reduce water pollution and protect environmental health. This represents a significant step towards more environmental protection.
